scope: Rules-based V2 critic for electric arc orb reads.

detection_rules: HeroElectricArc emitter is missing or under-authored.
The hero electric arc is not visually distinct from the support filaments.
hero_sweep_missing.escalation_rule: Two consecutive hero-layer failures force a rebuild.

detection_rules: HeroElectricArc does not establish an outer-zone to hot-core read.
no_outside_to_core_read.escalation_rule: Two consecutive failures force a rebuild.

detection_rules: Hero or support electric layers close into a ring shell around the orb.
closed_ring_orb.escalation_rule: If repeated on the hero silhouette, rebuild the hero electric arc layer.

detection_rules: Electric hero arc is rendered as a thin ribbon cage or wireframe shell.
wire_arc_cage.escalation_rule: Two consecutive hits force a hero rebuild.

secondary_overwhelms_hero.escalation_rule: Reduce support density before touching the hero arc.

detection_rules: Electric hero body reads too flame-like, broad, or molten instead of crisp charged arcs.
thick_flame_body.escalation_rule: Reduce flame-like body mass before adding more glow.

detection_rules: CoreElectricMass or BindGlow reads as a soft haze rather than a charged electric center.
soft_smoke_haze.escalation_rule: Fix the core charge read before polishing hero arcs.
